CustomField.label: Location + Date + Slot Type Key
CustomField.description: System-managed composite key = DVC_Tour_Location__c + DVC_Availability_Date__c + DVC_Slot_Type__c, populated by DVC_TourSlotGenerationService/DVC_TourSlotGenerationBatch before insert to enforce the uniqueness rule in LLD Section 15. Never edited directly by users.
